_comment: Merge the 'hooks' key below into your .claude/settings.json (replace /absolute/path/to with this repo's real path). Hook I/O contract verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md (permissionDecision/permissionDecisionReason nested under hookSpecificOutput; ask/deny/allow confirmed live in-session). Two hooks: Bash covers T1/T2 (install scan) and T10/T11 (integrity + protected-path writes via shell); Edit|Write covers T9 (MCP config registration) and T11 (direct edits to protected files).
